distribution: Jianou and Nanjing, Fujian; Nanxiong, Guangdong; Hainan; Shangqing, Jiangxi.
soldier: Head of the soldier intermediate between circular and square, widest at the antennal sockets, the pale T-shaped marking on the dorsum of the head distinct. Postclypeus arched, its length about one third of its width. Antennae with 14 segments, segment 2 longer than segment 4, segment 3 longer than segment 2. Dorsum of the abdomen with a few short hairs, the ventral surface with scattered longer hairs. Anterior half of the pronotum erect, equal in size to the posterior half, the anterior margin concave in the middle.
worker: Head of the worker deep yellow, sparsely hairy, abdomen pale yellowish white.
